author: Eric Skovan
text:
If you're talking about a sticky cover for the sensor, NO!, you cannot cover up the vent in the middle of the sensor. It will cause premature failure.

I had this happen once after using one, and I dug down on the Abbott site and confirmed this in the fine print.

I bought a ½" round punch to make holes in them.

text: I use full cover overlay and scan with phone works just fine
